stories.title: Street View shows McDonald’s losing its color, 2009 to 2025
stories.summary: A post put two Google Street View captures of the same McDonald’s side by side: a red roof, balloons and flower beds in October 2009, and a flat grey box in October 2025. It asked "I want someone to explain to me why the colors disappeared" and passed 20 million views. Thousands of replies and quote posts offered answers, from buildings that are easier to resell and the end of marketing to kids to minimalism, greed, or simply "we grew up, McDonald’s did too."
